newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee firm vs dlr,seen strong on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee firm vs dlr,seen strong on weak demand.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened at 56.84 per dollar on Monday, unchanged from its previous close, dealers said.
"The market is holding excess dollars," a dealer said. "We have requested the Napal Rastra Bank, the central bank of the country to intervene and buy the excess dollars from the market," he said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 7.00-7.50 percent on Monday, dealers said.
